headline.purpose: Section H2s, two lines, second line in Faint Grey.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: words-in
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, blur 10px to 0, y 0.28em to 0; 0.9s; 55ms stagger (headings), 12 to 18ms (body)
motion.purpose: Headings and body entering word by word.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, blur 8px to 0, y 12 to 40px to 0; 1.1s

motion.name: scene-swap
motion.value: opacity and blur 8px, scale 0.97 in / 1.02 out; 0.7s

motion.name: cycle
motion.value: Marketing 5.6s, Sales 5.0s, Compliance 6.2s per step; runs only when 35% in view, not hovered, not focused, not reduced motion
motion.purpose: Timed tabs, steps and rows, each with a 2px red timer bar.

motion.name: lead-token
motion.value: 1.1s walk to the active station on ease-out; jumps under reduced motion
motion.purpose: The red token on the Sales walkway.

motion.name: ink-on-scroll
motion.value: #c4c4c4 to #151515 per letter, scroll offset start 0.92 to start 0.4

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: 42s linear, pauses on hover; static wrapped row under reduced motion

motion.name: scene-pause
motion.value: IntersectionObserver, 120px root margin; pauses CSS (.is-paused) and SMIL
motion.purpose: Every isometric scene stops off screen.

components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 460px; } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 18px 20px 20px; text-align: left; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color .45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow .45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-tab.is-on { background: #fff; border-color: #ebebeb; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 14px 30px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22); } .ds-tab-title { font: 500 19px 'Space Grotesk Variable', 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: #8a8a8a; transition: color .4s; } .ds-tab:hover .ds-tab-title { color: #2a2a2a; } .ds-tab.is-on .ds-tab-title { color: #151515; } .ds-tab-body { font: 15px/1.5 'Inter Variable', Inter, sans-serif; color: #767676; } .ds-tab.is-on .ds-tab-body { color: #5f5f5f; } .ds-tab-timer { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: #e2332a; transform-origin: left; transform: scaleX(0.6); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #151515; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.northStar: The Blueprint With One Red Box
narrative.overview:
The page is a technical drawing on near-white stock. Two full-height hairline rails bound the content column, and every full-width rule that crosses them is pinned with a small plus crosshair, the way a draughtsman marks registration. Inside that frame everything is ink, grey and hairline. The imagery is a family of isometric line-art machines built from one toolkit (`src/lib/iso.tsx`, `src/lib/parts.tsx`), so line weight, shading and corner language never vary. The only chromatic colour on the page is signal red, and it lives on the E box and on whatever is live: packets riding wires, the walking lead token, timer bars, pulse rings.

Density is marketing-generous: 128px between sections, a centred two-line heading with one short body sentence, one idea per band, and a scene under or beside it that acts the idea out. Motion has one entrance grammar (words sharpening out of blur) plus looping machine motion that pauses off screen and never starts under reduced motion.

The page runs as a single story: Hero, Logos, Marketing (four timed tabs and scenes: Create, Publish, Budget, Capture), Sales (a six-station walkway with a red lead token and a hairline stepper), Autopilot (three routes from the engine over a three-lane hairline table), Compliance (a timed accordion beside a six-satellite hub), Stats, Integrations, Pricing, FAQ, CTA (a tower rising floor by floor), Footer.

Refused by the direction and absent from the build: skyline or building photography heroes, gradient SaaS blobs, glass panels, colour-coded feature icons, "Coming soon" tags.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white ground (#fcfcfc) as the page; pure white only for raised surfaces.
Two page-height hairline rails with plus crosshairs where rules meet them.
Space Grotesk display at weight 500 with tight negative tracking; Inter for everything read.
Two-tone headings: first line ink, second line grey.
Isometric ink line-art is the only imagery; red is the only colour in it.
Barely rounded geometry (3px surfaces, 4px tags, 5px buttons); no pills in the interface.
Every timed or looping element pauses off screen, on hover and on focus, and shows its final state under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Red Box Rule
rules.body: Red marks the E box and whatever is live right now: moving, counting down, pulsing, or the single active item in a scene. The one static red surface in the interface is the "Most popular" tag. It never fills a section, a card, a heading, a list, a resting link or an icon. If two unrelated things on screen are red and neither is moving, counting or the E, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Grey Lanes Rule
rules.body: The Autopilot lanes carry no red: grey arrows, dashed dividers, ink headings. The scene above them already carries the red packets; the table under it reads, it does not signal.

rules.name: The Two-Tone Heading Rule
rules.body: Section headings are two lines: the claim in Ink, the qualifier in Faint Grey, each line its own block so the break survives the word-by-word entrance. No italic, no accent colour, no underline inside a heading.

rules.name: The Indian Money Rule
rules.body: Money on this site is written the Indian way (Rs 39,999, Rs 1,29,999), never in dollars.

rules.name: The Any-State Rule
rules.body: Copy says "RERA" and never names one state's authority; state rules are added over time and the page must not age with them.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: A surface is separated by a 1px #ebebeb border before it is separated by a shadow. A shadow at rest belongs only to buttons and the active tab; everything else lifts only in response to state.

rules.name: The No Ink Card Rule
rules.body: There is no near-black card on this site. Dark mass lives in the drawings (ink blocks, the inked finished tile, the plinth) and in the primary button. Autopilot is a scene over a hairline table, not a dark panel.

dos: Do keep the page Blueprint Ground (#fcfcfc) and let Raised White (#ffffff) mark the only lifted surfaces.
Do separate with 1px #ebebeb hairlines, and pin every full-width rule to the rails with plus crosshairs.
Do write section headings as two lines, the second in Faint Grey (#8a8a8a).
Do build new imagery from the isometric toolkit, and keep red to the E box and what is live: packets, the lead token, timer bars, pulse rings, the one active item in a scene.
Do give every scene an `aria-label` sentence, and exclude packets (`.pk`) from any auto-framed bounds.
Do pause every looping or timed element off screen, on hover and on focus, and render its final state under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do draw a compact layout for a scene whose marks would fall below legible size under 640px, rather than shrinking the wide one.
Do write money as Rs 35,000 or Rs 1.25 Cr, and say "RERA" without naming a state.
donts: Don't use red as a fill for sections, cards, headings, lists, icons or resting links (The One Red Box Rule); the Autopilot lanes stay grey.
Don't add a second accent colour, a gradient wash, or colour-coded icons.
Don't add a near-black card or panel; dark mass belongs to the drawings and the primary button.
Don't use skyline or building photography, or AI-drawn buildings, as imagery.
Don't round surfaces past 3px or turn buttons or tags into pills.
Don't put a shadow on a surface at rest other than a button or the active tab.
Don't add "Coming soon" tags; the page presents the whole product.
Don't use an em dash or en dash anywhere in the copy; recast the sentence.
